rationale.conceptual: Established but non-trivial method (periodic UHF) needing careful implementation of basis set input, spin configurations, and projected density of states extraction; requires understanding of quantum chemistry and solid-state physics but no novel algorithm development.
rationale.execution: Three sequential steps with dependencies: prepare input files for CP2K (including basis set data entry and supercell geometry), run two UHF calculations, post-process to obtain PDOS and band gap. Involves a specialized open-source tool (CP2K) and handling of spin-polarized supercells, but pipeline is manageable.

difficulty.reasoning: Periodic HF calculation with a standard method (CRYSTAL/CP2K) on a tiny system, requiring careful input setup and PDOS extraction; moderate conceptual difficulty due to basis set handling and spin ordering; moderate execution with 3-step pipeline.

compute_estimate.reasoning: The system (KNiF3 perovskite) has only 10 atoms in the doubled AFM cell with ~166 basis functions; Hartree-Fock SCF is CPU-only and scales trivially on modern hardware; data input is just basis set coefficients and geometry, negligible volume.
